description: This file defines the Banner model class for the Opencart admin design module. It contains methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting banner records and their associated images in the database.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Model class for managing banners in the database, including CRUD operations and associated images.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Creates a new banner record in the database with provided data, including images if present.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified banner.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates the banner's data and images in the database.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner and its associated images from the database.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves a specific banner record by its ID.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of banners based on filter criteria, including sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total number of banner records in the database.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image record associated with a specific banner and language.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specific banner.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes images associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images for a specific banner and language.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all images for a specific language.
